Class.name: IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Service.Hl7FileCopyScheduler
Class.Description: Triggers the file copy operation at regular interval set in the management portal settings....

Parameter.name: ADAPTER
Parameter.Description: Use the Adapter to invoke this service every set amount of time

Method.name: OnProcessInput
Method.Implementation:
#dim tSC As %Status = $$$OK #dim pRequest As Ens.StringRequest #dim pResponse As Ens.StringResponse #dim alertRequest As Ens.AlertRequest set pRequest=##class(Ens.StringRequest).%New() set pRequest.StringValue="Triggering CopyFile At "_$ZDATETIME($H) set tSC=..SendRequestSync(..TargetConfigNames,pRequest,.pResponse) if (pResponse.StringValue["FAILED") { set alertRequest=##class(Ens.AlertRequest).%New() set alertRequest.AlertText=pResponse.StringValue set alertRequest.SourceConfigName=..%ConfigName do ..SendAlert(alertRequest) }
quit tSC

Method.name: OnGetConnections
Method.Description: Return an array of connections for drawing lines on the config diagram
